test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 14 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A, B and C can complete a piece of work in 8, 10 and 12 days, respectively. In how many days would all of them complete the same work, working together?
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete the work in 8 days.

B can complete the work in 10 days.

C can complete the work in 12 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done per day by all working together = ((1)/(A) + (1)/(B) + (1)/(C))

Time taken to complete the work together = 1/(Work done per day by all working together)

**Calculation:**

Work done per day by A = 1/8

Work done per day by B = 1/10

Work done
